description: This source file defines a Java class 'LoginEventListener' that implements the HttpSessionListener interface. It listens for session creation and destruction events in a web application, performing actions such as logging a verbose message when a session is created and cleaning up external login keys when a session is destroyed.

classes.name: LoginEventListener
classes.description: A listener for HTTP session events that logs session creation and performs cleanup on session destruction.

methods.name: sessionCreated
methods.description: Handles the HTTP session creation event; logs a verbose message indicating no action is taken on session creation.

methods.name: sessionDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the HTTP session destruction event; calls cleanup of external login keys associated with the session.
